title: Taarifa ya Wiki

headings.text: Mchango wa Ujenzi wa Ukumbi wa Parokia

key_sentences: Karibuni nyote katika ibada za wiki hii.
Tunawashukuru wote waliojitolea kusafisha uwanja wa kanisa Jumamosi iliyopita.
Misa ya Jumapili ijayo itaongozwa na Paroko msaidizi.
Kamati ya ujenzi inawaomba waumini wote kukamilisha ahadi zao kabla ya mwisho wa mwezi Desemba.
Jumamosi tarehe 21 Novemba kutakuwa na harambee ya kuchangia ujenzi wa ukumbi baada ya Misa ya jioni.
Wanajumuiya wote wanaombwa kufika mapema na kuwakaribisha wageni.

list_items.text: Mafundisho ya kipaimara yanaendelea kila Jumamosi saa 8:00 mchana.
Kikundi cha vijana kitakuwa na mkutano Jumanne saa 11:00 jioni.
Wazazi wanaotaka watoto wao wabatizwe wajiandikishe ofisini kabla ya tarehe 30 Novemba.
Sadaka ya pili ya leo ni kwa ajili ya kituo cha wazee.

furniture: PAROKIA YA MT. YOSEFU MFANYAKAZI – MLIMANI
Ofisi ya Parokia: Jumanne hadi Jumamosi, saa 3:00 asubuhi hadi saa 9:00 alasiri
notes: One page, Swahili. The purple masthead (parish name, letter-spaced; postal line; issue line) and the footer (office hours, web address) are furniture. Swahili clock times ("Saa 1:00 asubuhi") are given as written. Two columns sit side by side under the intro: the left column ("Ratiba ya Ibada" heading, table, one sentence) is read completely before the right column ("Matangazo" heading and CSS-drawn bullet list). The contributions table has a total row "Jumla". The readings box lists three reading references as separate body lines.
